svg.title: Learning sequence roadmap including SecOps threaded through all phases
svg.desc: Six phases with SecOps items threaded throughout: Phase 0 dev environment, Phase 1 foundation, Phase 2 backend core, Phase 3 frontend and auth, Phase 4 cloud infrastructure and hardening, Phase 5 operations and SecOps.

g.text: Set this up once, before writing a single line of app code
Learn the building blocks before generating any code
Build the API by hand before generating anything
OWASP Top 10 — apply while building API
Add the client layer once the API contract is stable
Proposals, RSVPs, .ics feed generation, group calendar URL
HashiCorp Vault — secrets injection into NestJS and Docker Compose
Group chat — @nestjs/websockets, Socket.io, JWT on handshake
Deploy once the app works end-to-end locally, then lock it down
Once the system is live and stable
